document: Invitation to an event or meeting
glossary: Document type: Invitation to an event or meeting. Field names are English identifiers; the document text is verbatim, usually Hungarian.

field_specs.organizer: the organizer as printed on the document (A szervezo/meghivo fel neve, aki a rendezvenyt tartja (pl. Magyar Curling Szovetseg))
field_specs.event_name: the event name as printed on the document (Az esemeny sajat neve/cime, ahogy a dokumentumon szerepel (pl. 2026. evi szezonzaro dijatado gala))
field_specs.event_datetime: the event datetime as printed on the document (Az esemeny idopontja ISO YYYY-MM-DD formatumban, orat csatolva ha szerepel (pl. 2026-05-27 17:30); magyar datumot normalizalj, null ha nincs)
field_specs.location_address: the location address as printed on the document (A helyszin es postai cim, ahogy nyomtatva all (pl. Rubin Wellness & Conference Hotel, 1118 Budapest, Dayka Gabor u. 3.))
field_specs.venue_room: the venue room as printed on the document (A helyszinen beluli konkret terem/helyseg neve, ha megnevezik (pl. Siraly terem); kulonben null)
field_specs.registration_info: the registration info as printed on the document (A regisztracio/reszvetel modja ahogy szerepel: link, e-mail, telefonszam, hatarido vagy gombfelirat (pl. Regisztralok az esemenyre); kulonben null)
